steps.content: Boom!!
The fight ended quickly. The fallen wall from the heights crashed to the ground, scaring off the gangsters. It's Nightmare who snuck over and helped from a blind spot on top of a ruined building.

Hecate can't make sense of Donald's behavior, and she doesn't want to waste any more time waiting. She wanted this powerful man to go and look for ${PlayerName} immediately, so she risked exposure and helped him clear the obstacles.
She isn't aware that this ridiculous and time-wasting farce has also helped release the tension within her.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Sob... Ouch...
Now the obstacles have been cleared, but the man she considers invincible is still lying on the ground. From its high vantage point, Nightmare can see him clutching his clothes and sobbing.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Sob... Those meanies scared me to death... Sob...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: He isn't that badly injured, is he...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Isn't he supposed to save Chief? Isn't he supposed to go to BR-002? What on earth is he...
What's happening here?
Several white figures suddenly approach.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: An FAC patrol? Did they sense Nightmare's attack?

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: What was that explosion just now? Did another Sinner lose control?

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Be careful, they're now all connected to the Black Ring, the only active contamination that leaks out of the FAC's blockade. We must...
They turn around to search for suspicious Sinners.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: <size=45>Please, FAC sirs, help!!</size>
A pair of arms grabs the FAC soldier around his waist. Donald springs up to cling to the leading FAC soldier and starts crying loudly. Caught off guard, the armored soldier is unable to move.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Look at me, I'm an Executive Officer, from the Executive Committee! Those damn gangsters are attacking us on the streets. Help me, please! Take me back!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I'm injured, I need medical attention. There's no time to go back to the Executive Committee. Take me to your base, please. I'll be forever in your debt!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: We will, but the matter of the Sinner is more pressing...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Awwwww! It's killing me! Stop talking about that Sinner now. Someone's about to die here. Arghhh, I'm dying!!

Distracted by this grown man throwing a tantrum, the FAC soldiers can't break away to search for the suspicious Sinner nearby. Their expressions shift from confused to helpless, then suddenly, they seem to realize something.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Could you be... Donald, that Executive Officer who was kidnapped a while ago?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You guys know me?

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Haha... You're well known for your unique character. We've been wanting to meet you for so long.
They smile knowingly and squat down to help Donald up, or rather, prop him up.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Before we take you back to the Executive Committee, please come with us to the FAC first.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Oh No!

She turns to chase after those people, but when she looks back, she sees an unexpected figure already standing behind her. The person taps the young girl's shoulder and gestures for her to keep quiet.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: …It's you?
The old man's name is Samuel and he claims to be Donald's assistant. During the Ten Days of Rustfire, he saved Hella and Hecate with Donald and escorted the girls to a refugee camp.
His past is equally mysterious, with his age and affiliations unknown. Hecate can only confirm that he has no combat abilities, is not a Sinner, and is extremely low-key and reticent.
Hecate takes a step back, showing a resistant expression.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I won't go back. Rustfire can't give me what I want, so this time I will find the information myself.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: I know, but you can't catch up to him.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Follow me.

Indeed, she can't risk discovery by the FAC, or she will surely get locked back into the MBCC for her contamination. Hecate hesitates for a moment before she follows the old man, heading toward the red halo not far away and the stronghold glowing with a blue light beneath it which seems so small in comparison.

BR-002
FAC Black Ring Blockade Frontline - Stronghold S1

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Hello, Executive Officer Donald. Do you remember the <color=#fb9259>FAC-Propulsion Type 023 Bastion</color> you borrowed from us in March?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Although the Executive Committee claims you're only mentally unstable, we all know about your special background.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: An Executive Officer appointed by Paradeisos's Hush with experience dealing with BR-002 and a deep understanding of Rustfire. The 9th Agency has introduced you to us. Now, please come with me. The FAC requires your valuable assistance.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hush who? I have no idea who you're talking about! I don't rely on connections! But sure, with pleasure, I miss you guys to pieces too.
He grins, his earlier craziness gone.
